items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: But Jilly loved us and Frank came by a couple of times.

ctx.x: Oh you don’t know Jilly’s? The club in New York. It was big in — how shall I say it — the powerful Italian people would congregate there. And it was a hangout of Frank’s, Frank S. And those people loved to have a good time and back then throughout the ‘40s, ‘50s and ‘60s they hired good music a lot of them. They had good taste in music in my opinion. And we sort of fit into that crowd for a few minutes. That scene was sort of on the way down by the time we got there, ‘76, ‘77. But Jilly loved us and Frank came by…
Can I ask you what you would make on a typical night place like that?
